This product is supplied without battery and charger. Makita 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 676YX.

Cordless inflator powered by the 18V LXT lithium battery platform. Suitable for inflating car and cycle tyres and all types of sports balls. Target pressure can be set to a desired level and upon reaching this pressure the machine will automatically cut out. Memory function logs the pressure set from the previous use. Other features include a digital pressure gauge (with backlight), LED work light for easy operation in the dark, soft-grip ergonomic handle and adaptor holder.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
